ownershipRules.rule: Can create, edit, activate, deactivate, and view only products owned by the same vendor_id.
Can view only orders containing order_items assigned to the same vendor_id.
Can view and manage only carts, orders, addresses, and saved items linked to the same user_id.
Can manage marketplace-wide settings, vendors, catalog moderation, disputes, and payouts.

checkoutControls.transactionBoundary: Create parent checkout, child vendor orders, order_items, payment intent reference, and ledger pending entries atomically.
checkoutControls.ledgerRule: Vendor ledger entries are append-only. Corrections require reversal entries, not mutation.

aiControls.fallbackBehavior: If AI output fails validation, keep the last valid site schema and ask the user for one clarifying detail.

rules: Every vendor-owned record must include vendor_id.
Every business/site-owned record must include business_id.
Public storefront reads can only expose active and published records.
Admin writes must be audit logged with actor_user_id and role.
